blocks.prompt: 13 Show that \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{f(x)}{1 + e^x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx\), where \(f(x)\) is an even function. Hence or otherwise evaluate \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{x^2}{1 + e^x}\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein symmetric interval \([-a, a]\) hai aur neeche \(1 + e^x\). Aise sawal Example 54 jaise hote hain.
Diya kya hai? \(f\) even function hai, yani \(f(-x) = f(x)\).
Kya saabit karna hai? Ke \(\frac{1}{1 + e^x}\) wala factor poore interval ko aadha kar deta hai, yani integral \(\int_0^a f\) ban jata hai.
Rule kaunsa? Property V: \(\int_{-a}^{a} h = \int_0^a [h(x) + h(-x)]\). \(h(x) + h(-x)\) jor kar dekhenge to seedha \(f(x)\) banta hai.
Phir \(f(x) = x^2\) (jo even hai) par result lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(-x) = f(x)\).
Saabit karna: \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{f(x)}{1 + e^x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx\); phir \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{x^2}{1 + e^x}\,dx\) nikalna.
Tareeqa: Property V \(\int_{-a}^{a} h(x)\,dx = \int_0^a \big(h(x) + h(-x)\big)\,dx\), jahan \(h(x) = \frac{f(x)}{1 + e^x}\).

\(h(-x)\) nikalein
\[h(-x) = \dfrac{f(-x)}{1 + e^{-x}} = \dfrac{f(x)\,e^{x}}{e^{x} + 1}\]
Kyun: \(f\) even hai to \(f(-x) = f(x)\). Phir upar neeche \(e^{x}\) se multiply kiya taa ke \(e^{-x}\) khatam ho: \((1 + e^{-x})e^{x} = e^{x} + 1\).

\(h(x) + h(-x)\) jama karein
\[\dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^x} + \dfrac{f(x)\,e^x}{1 + e^x} = \dfrac{f(x)(1 + e^x)}{1 + e^x}\]
\[= f(x)\]
Kyun: dono ka denominator ek hai, numerators jama kiye aur \(f(x)\) common nikala; \(1 + e^x\) cancel ho gaya. Yahi woh jaadu hai jo is sawal ko aasaan banata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(f\) ke even hone ki shart isi qadam mein kaam aayi; agar \(f\) even na ho to yeh cancel nahi hota.

Property V lagayein
\[\int_{-a}^{a} \dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property V mein bracket ki jagah \(f(x)\) rakha; saboot mukammal.

Ab \(f(x) = x^2\) ke saath
\[\int_{-a}^{a} \dfrac{x^2}{1 + e^x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} x^2\,dx\]
\[= \left[\dfrac{x^3}{3}\right]_{0}^{a} = \dfrac{a^3}{3}\]
Kyun: \((-x)^2 = x^2\), to \(x^2\) even hai aur saabit kiya hua result seedha lagta hai. 'Hence' ka yahi matlab hai.

Tasdeeq
\[a = 2:\ \int_{-2}^{2} \dfrac{x^2}{1 + e^x}\,dx \approx 2.6667 = \dfrac{8}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a = 2\) le kar calculator se numerical value 2.6667 aati hai, jo \(\frac{2^3}{3}\) hai. Answer key mein bhi \(\frac{a^3}{3}\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{f(x)}{1 + e^x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx\); aur \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{x^2}{1 + e^x}\,dx = \frac{a^3}{3}\).
